memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light. - Gen 1:3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Into the darkness, God speaks. And the moment He speaks, light appears. There is no struggle, no effort, no delay. God simply says the word, and it is done. This tells us something wonderful about our God: His word carries power. What He says, happens.

Think about that for a moment. The whole universe listens when God speaks. And this same God has spoken to us, in His Word, the Bible, and supremely through His Son. When God gives a promise, you can rest on it completely, because the One who promised has the power to bring it to pass.

There is also a deeper picture here. Light pushing back darkness is one of Scripture's great themes. God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all (1 Jn 1:5). And when Jesus came, He said, "I am the light of the world" (Jn 8:12). The same God who spoke light into a dark universe shines His light into dark hearts, showing us the way to Him.

Wherever there is darkness in your life today, confusion, fear, or sin, remember that God's word still has the power to bring light. Ask Him to speak, and to shine His light into every corner.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What area of your life needs God's light to break through the darkness?
2. Do you truly believe God's word has the power to change your situation?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You spoke light into darkness, and it obeyed. Speak Your light into my heart today, and help me walk in it. Amen.
